instruction:
Fix `plugins/notifications/src/components/UnreadNotificationsCard/UnreadNotificationsCard.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. CI=true yarn test plugins/notifications/src/components/UnreadNotificationsCard/UnreadNotificationsCard.test.tsx exits 1: Tests: 7 failed, 7 total. The file on disk is still the first version.
(1) Six tests fail with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'id')` at TestApiRegistry `new Map(apis.map(([api, impl]) => [api.id, impl]))` (packages/test-utils/src/testUtils/TestApiProvider.tsx:70): line 27 imports `toastApiRef` from '@backstage/core-plugin-api/alpha', which does not export it. Import `toastApiRef` from '@backstage/frontend-plugin-api', as UnreadNotificationsCard.tsx line 29 does. This is also a TypeScript error that breaks `yarn tsc`.
(2) The widget test reads `HomePageWidgetBlueprint.dataRefs.components` (line 478), which does not exist: the blueprint's only data ref is `dataRefs.widget` (HomePageWidgetBlueprint.tsx lines 79-85). Earlier attempts also failed on `tester.render is not a function` and on passing a FrontendModule to `.add()`: use only the methods createExtensionTester.tsx actually defines. Move the HomePageWidgetBlueprint import from line 505 to the top import block.
(3) The previous fix round corrected (1) and (2) but then every attempt failed on a Testing Library query whose error printed the rendered card DOM (a react-aria ButtonIcon with id "react-aria-:r14:", class bui-ButtonIconContent, an svg icon inside). That is the error a getBy/findBy query throws when it finds no match or more than one. Write every query against what UnreadNotificationsCard.tsx actually renders: read its title, link text and href, the mark-as-read button's accessible name (its aria-label from the translation), and the empty-state text from the component and translation.ts, not from the plan. Where several items render the same button, use findAllByRole or scope the query with `within(...)` on the item; use `{ name: ... }` with the exact accessible name. Keep screen + findBy* queries, no waitFor where findBy* works, no test IDs, the Apache-2.0 2026 header, and the seven test cases.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.

## Answer
Return ONLY a JSON object {"path": "plugins/notifications/src/components/UnreadNotificationsCard/UnreadNotificationsCard.test.tsx", "edits": [{"search": "<text copied exactly from the current text>", "replace": "<its replacement>"}]} with no other text. Each search must appear exactly once in the current text; the edits apply in order.
If the file does not exist yet, or the change rewrites most of it, return {"path": "plugins/notifications/src/components/UnreadNotificationsCard/UnreadNotificationsCard.test.tsx", "content": "<the complete file>"} instead.
